# ProtoPart category taxonomy 2.1.0

`category-taxonomy-2.1.0.json` is an unchanged copy of the category taxonomy
that Delta Robotics published with its ProtoPart parts library (version
2.1.0, `contribution/category-taxonomy.json`). The UHD taxonomy is derived
from it, and `test/taxonomy.test.ts` checks that UHD keeps each of its 77
nodes byte for byte.

Only the taxonomy is copied here. The ProtoPart parts, kit manifests and
other library files are not part of UHD.
